content:
The Indian used-car market is seeing an interesting shift.

Spinny crossed ₹6,000 crore in revenue, growing 28%+ in FY26.

Meanwhile, Cars24’s India revenue declined 18.3% to ₹5,092 crore, while its core used-car business fell 22.7% to ₹4,349 crore.

On the positive side, Cars24 narrowed its net loss by 18.8% to ₹441 crore.

Spinny also raised $320 million, giving it more room to scale.

Once the challenger, Spinny has now emerged as a leading player in India’s used-car retail space.

If this trajectory continues, FY27 could make the race even more interesting.

#Spinny #Cars24 #Startups #AutoTech #UsedCars #BusinessStrategy
comment: Revenue growth is only one side of the used-car battle. Long-term winners may be decided by inventory quality, trust mechanisms, and repeat customer economics rather than just transaction volume.
